title: Chrome Bloom
description: Liquid chrome flows continuously, speeds up with percussion, and eases back to a visible slow flow between beats.

parameters.label: Flow
parameters.description: Continuous stretching and gathering of the metal curves, independent of rotation.

parameters.label: Tube Width
parameters.description: Thickness of the interlocked metal curves.

parameters.label: Fold
parameters.description: Twist and deformation of the metal form.

parameters.label: Polish
parameters.description: Contrast and strength of the reflected studio lights.

parameters.label: Exposure
parameters.description: Overall sculptural light without lifting the background.

parameters.label: Turn
parameters.description: Slow overall rotation, independent of the liquid shape flow.

parameters.label: Music Drive
parameters.description: Increase the speed of the continuous shape flow.

parameters.label: Inner Reach
parameters.description: Draw the inner curve out through the opening, with shifting reflections.

parameters.label: Framing
parameters.description: Size of the sculpture in the frame.

provenance.prompt_summary: Liquid chrome flows continuously, speeds up with percussion, and eases back to a visible slow flow between beats.
